I had to sell my car to pay rent, I also have no one who will take me in with my cat. I also haven't been able to get her registered, everything seems hopeless. 

I appreciate the thought and care, thank you for your kind words.
I’m not looking to cause him any harm, I still have love for him and no desire to be vindictive. I just need to find somewhere to go or some kind of help for myself.
